project_desc_1: I started this to find out how far I could get building with AI assistance. The original {link} had stopped being maintained, so there was something real to rebuild rather than a toy project. It has been running at my own feeder ever since.
project_desc_2: Frigate watches the feeder and flags anything that looks like a bird. YA-WAMF classifies it, checks it against BirdNET-Go audio, and stores the result. Every photo on this page came off that camera.
